items.title: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Q2 profit more than doubles to ₹53 crore
items.text: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd (ABFRL) on Saturday reported a twofold increase in consolidated net profit at Rs 53.05 crore for September quarter FY27. The company had posted a net profit of Rs 23.44 crore during July-September FY26, according to a regulatory filing from ABFRL. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 2,265.61 crore from Rs 2,037.90 crore earlier. Total expenses of ABFRL, which handles Pantaloons and Style Up, along with a host of ethnic brands, were at Rs 2,224.99 crore, up 9.71 per cent in the second quarter of FY27. Total income, including other income, was up 11.48 per cent
items.summary: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd (ABFRL) on Saturday reported a twofold increase in consolidated net profit at Rs 53.05 crore for September quarter FY27.

items.title: Govt raises windfall tax on diesel by ₹3, ATF by 50 paise per litre
items.text: The government on Saturday hiked windfall gains tax on export of diesel and ATF and slashed the levy to zero on petrol for the fortnight beginning October 31. For ATF exports, the duty has been hiked marginally to Rs 11/litre, from Rs 10.5/litre for the fortnight. The rate of special additional excise duty (SAED), along with road and infrastructure cess on export of diesel, will now be Rs 11.5 a litre, up from Rs 8.5 a litre. Duty on petrol exports has been slashed to nil, from Rs 2.5 per litre, for the next fortnight. The finance ministry in a notification said the duty changes will be effect
items.summary: The government increased windfall tax on diesel exports by ₹3 per litre to ₹11.5 per litre, and on ATF exports by 50 paise to ₹11 per litre. It removed the tax on petrol exports entirely for the next fortnight.

items.title: Centre sets up panel to improve uptake of RELIEF scheme for exporters
items.text: The commerce ministry has set up a six-member committee for better utilisation of funds and improved uptake of the RELIEF initiative for exporters. RELIEF (Resilience and Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation) is an initiative of the government launched under the Rs 25,060-crore Export Promotion Mission (EPM). It is aimed at protecting exporters from soaring freight costs, increased insurance premiums, and maritime trade disruptions in the Gulf and West Asian corridors. In a trade notice, the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has said a sub-committee for RELIEF shall be cons
items.summary: The Centre formed a six-member committee to improve fund utilization and uptake of the RELIEF scheme for exporters. RELIEF, launched under the ₹25,060-crore Export Promotion Mission, aims to protect exporters from high freight costs, insurance premiums, and trade disruptions in Gulf and West Asian corridors.
items.title_hi: केंद्र ने निर्यातकों के लिए RELIEF योजना का लाभ बढ़ाने के लिए पैनल बनाया

items.title: Commerce ministry sets up committee for better utilisation of RELIEF initiative for exporters
items.text: The commerce ministry has established a six-member committee to enhance the RELIEF initiative for exporters. This initiative aims to mitigate challenges posed by rising freight costs and insurance premiums. The committee includes officials from various government departments working to improve fund utilization. It will assess the implementation of the initiative and recommend measures for better uptake. The overall goal is to support exporters during trade disruptions in crucial regions.
items.summary: The commerce ministry formed a six-member committee to improve the RELIEF initiative for exporters. The initiative addresses rising freight costs and insurance premiums. The committee will assess implementation and recommend measures for better fund utilization to support exporters during trade disruptions.

items.title: Sudhanshu Trivedi targets Congress over mock Parliament, cites World Bank report
items.text: Sudhanshu Trivedi criticized the Congress party for organizing a mock Parliament after their recent failures. He emphasized the significant reduction in poverty in India under Prime Minister Narendra Modi's leadership from 2011 to 2023. Trivedi referenced the World Bank's report claiming only 2.6 percent of the population remains in extreme poverty today. The Gini Index results also showed that India ranks among the most economically equal countries globally.

items.text: Leaders of the Opposition INDIA bloc are set to travel in open buses to a rally in Delhi. This rally is intended to address alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has called upon citizens to participate in the November 1 march for democracy. The march will start at Minto Road-Connaught Place junction and end at Ramlila Maidan.

items.text: Rahul Gandhi has invited everyone to join a march to Ramlila Maidan on November 1 for a rally. items.title: IGL Q2 result: Net profit plunges 93.5% to ₹24 crore on higher gas costs
items.text: Indraprastha Gas Ltd (IGL), the country's largest city gas distributor, reported a sharp 93.5 per cent decline in standalone net profit for the September quarter as a substantial increase in input gas costs eroded margins, offsetting higher sales volumes and revenue. Net profit fell to Rs 24.38 crore in the second quarter of 2026-27 from Rs 372.51 crore a year earlier, despite an 8 per cent increase in sales volumes and a 26 per cent jump in gross turnover. The company said its average daily gas sales crossed the 10 million standard cubic metres per day (mmscmd) mark for the first time, rising
items.summary: IGL's standalone net profit plunged 93.5% to ₹24.38 crore in Q2 due to sharply higher input gas costs. Revenue grew 26% and sales volumes rose 8%, but margins were eroded. Average daily gas sales crossed 10 mmscmd for the first time.
items.title_hi: IGL Q2 परिणाम: अधिक गैस लागत के कारण शुद्ध लाभ 93.5% गिरकर ₹24 करोड़
items.summary_hi: IGL का स्टैंडअलोन शुद्ध लाभ Q2 में तेजी से 93.5% गिरकर ₹24.38 करोड़ हो गया क्योंकि इनपुट गैस लागत में भारी वृद्धि ने मार्जिन को कम कर दिया। राजस्व 26% बढ़ा और बिक्री मात्रा 8% बढ़ी, लेकिन मार्जिन घट गए। औसत दैनिक गैस बिक्री पहली बार 10 mmscmd को पार कर गई।

items.title: Karnataka sugarcane growers stage demo to press for their demands, district officials impose restrictions
items.text: Farmers in North Karnataka are intensifying their protest over the procurement price of sugarcane and other related issues. They staged blockades and sit-ins across several locations including Belagavi and Dharwad. The farmers are demanding a fair price of Rs 5,500 per tonne for sugarcane and other reforms. Local administrations have imposed prohibitory orders to prevent further protests on highways.
items.summary: Karnataka sugarcane growers are protesting for a fair procurement price of Rs 5,500 per tonne and other reforms. They have staged blockades and sit-ins in Belagavi and Dharwad, leading local authorities to impose prohibitory orders on highways.

He identified a gap between scientific discovery and real-world adoption as one of the biggest challenges facing healthcare systems across bo
items.summary: UK Health Minister James Frith urged faster adoption of healthcare innovations between India and UK. Speaking at the Westminster Diwali event in London, he noted progress since the CETA implementation in mid-July. He said the gap between scientific discovery and real-world adoption remains a major challenge.

items.title: 'Took stock of our bilateral cooperation': EAM Jaishankar meets US Secy of State Rubio on sidelines of G20
items.text: S Jaishankar held a bilateral meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Atlanta. The meeting focused on enhancing India-US cooperation and addressing geopolitical issues. Jaishankar emphasized that military solutions are not viable for resolving global challenges. items.summary_hi: अक्टूबर के दौरान कच्ची चीनी के दाम लगभग 10% बढ़े। इसी अवधि में रोबस्टा कॉफी के दाम करीब 6% गिरे।

items.title: Nasdaq 100 cracks 5%, wipes out $2 trillion in October as AI spending fears deepen
items.text: Investor concerns about the high expenditures on artificial intelligence have intensified amidst rising borrowing costs. Major technology companies like Meta, Alphabet, and Microsoft are increasing their capital outlays to strengthen AI infrastructure. The Nasdaq 100 index has already seen a significant decline of more than 5.8% in October. Analysts predict that global AI infrastructure spending could reach unprecedented levels by 2030.
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 fell more than 5% in October, erasing about $2 trillion in value. Investors are worried about high spending on artificial intelligence by big tech companies like Meta, Alphabet and Microsoft, while borrowing costs are rising.
items.title_hi: नैस्डैक 100 में 5% की गिरावट, अक्टूबर में $2 ट्रिलियन साफ़ हुए क्योंकि AI खर्च की चिंता बढ़ी
items.summary_hi: अक्टूबर में नैस्डैक 100 5% से ज़्यादा गिरा और लगभग $2 ट्रिलियन की वैल्यू खत्म हो गई। निवेशक बड़ी टेक कंपनियों — मेटा, अल्फाबेट और माइक्रोसॉफ्ट — के AI पर भारी खर्च और बढ़ती ब्याज दरों से चिंतित हैं।

items.title: Nasdaq 100 Hits Third Correction of 2026 on Unwinding Tech Stock Bets
items.text: Investors dumped big tech stocks following a slew of disappointing earnings, putting the Nasdaq 100 Index on course to enter its third technical correction of the year.
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 entered its third technical correction of 2026 after investors sold big tech stocks following disappointing earnings.
items.title_hi: नैस्डैक 100 2026 में तीसरी बार करेक्शन में आया क्योंकि टेक शेयरों की बिकवाली हुई
items.summary_hi: निराशाजनक नतीजों के बाद निवेशकों ने बड़ी टेक कंपनियों के शेयर बेचे, जिससे नैस्डैक 100 2026 में तीसरी बार तकनीकी करेक्शन में चला गया।

items.title: Supreme Court asks poll panel to examine bulk filing of Form 7 in Uttar Pradesh
items.text: The direction came after the court was informed about alleged irregularities in the filing of Form 7 applications, including instances in which a large number of objections were submitted against voters belonging to a particular community.
items.summary: The Supreme Court directed the election commission to examine bulk filing of Form 7 in Uttar Pradesh. This follows allegations of irregularities including targeted objections against voters of a particular community.
items.title_hi: Supreme Court ने poll panel को Uttar Pradesh में Form 7 की bulk filing जांचने को कहा
items.summary_hi: Supreme Court ने चुनाव आयोग को Uttar Pradesh में Form 7 की bulk filing की जांच का निर्देश दिया। आरोप हैं कि एक विशेष समुदाय के voters के खिलाफ बड़ी संख्या में objections दायर की गईं।

items.title: Amit Shah lays out UP poll agenda: UCC and Hindutva
items.text: Amit Shah praised CM Yogi Adityanath's law-and-order record and implementation of central welfare schemes, amid speculation over differences between the state leadership and the BJP's central leadership. Addressing BJP's state executive meeting in Lucknow, Shah asked party workers to put aside all doubts and distractions and focus single-mindedly on the party's victory.
items.summary: Amit Shah outlines the UP election agenda focusing on UCC and Hindutva. He praised CM Yogi Adityanath's law-and-order record and urged party workers to focus on victory.
items.title_hi: अमित शाह ने रखा UP चुनाव एजेंडा: UCC और हिंदुत्व
items.summary_hi: अमित शाह ने UP चुनाव का एजेंडा बताया: UCC और हिंदुत्व। उन्होंने CM योगी आदित्यनाथ के काम की तारीफ की और कार्यकर्ताओं से जीत पर ध्यान देने को कहा।

items.title: MLC results shape of things to come in 2027: Akhilesh Yadav
items.text: Akhilesh Yadav highlighted the Samajwadi Party's recent successes in the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections. He believes these results reflect the BJP's diminishing political strength in the state. Yadav pointed out that BJP lost significant ground in Varanasi, emphasising that the party is vulnerable as elections approach. He also accused Yogi Adityanath of sacrificing Varanasi for Gorakhpur's gain.
items.summary: Akhilesh Yadav says Samajwadi Party's wins in Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections show BJP's declining strength. He notes BJP lost ground in Varanasi and accuses Yogi Adityanath of favoring Gorakhpur over Varanasi.
items.title_hi: MLC परिणाम 2027 की तस्वीर: अखिलेश यादव
items.summary_hi: अखिलेश यादव का कहना है कि समाजवादी पार्टी की उत्तर प्रदेश विधान परिषद चुनाव में जीत भाजपा की घटती ताकत दिखाती है। वे बताते हैं कि भाजपा वाराणसी में कमजोर हुई है और योगी आदित्यनाथ पर वाराणसी की कीमत पर गोरखपुर को फायदा पहुंचाने का आरोप लगाते हैं।

items.title: Opposition defers CEC mock impeachment due to rain
items.text: The Opposition INDIA bloc has postponed the mock impeachment event against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to Saturday due to rain. Leaders resolved to ensure Sunday’s rally at Ramlila Ground will demonstrate their strength and support. Rahul Gandhi accused the home minister of attempting to prevent people from reaching the rally. The event will include a march from Minto Road to Ramlila Maidan as planned.
items.summary: Opposition INDIA bloc postponed mock impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to Saturday due to rain. They plan a Sunday rally at Ramlila Ground with a march from Minto Road, and Rahul Gandhi accused the home minister of blocking attendance.
items.title_hi: विपक्ष ने बारिश के कारण CEC महाभियोग मॉक स्थगित किया
items.summary_hi: विपक्षी INDIA ब्लॉक ने मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के खिलाफ मॉक महाभियोग कार्यक्रम बारिश के कारण शनिवार तक टाल दिया। वे रविवार को रामलीला मैदान में रैली करेंगे जिसमें मिंटो रोड से मार्च शामिल है। राहुल गांधी ने गृह मंत्री पर रैली में लोगों को आने से रोकने का आरोप लगाया।

items.title: Arini Gets Bids on Junk Debt From Pimco, Oaktree as Losses Mount
items.text: Arini Capital Management, which has been beset with losses this month, has gotten bids on some of its high-yield debt holdings from asset managers including Pacific Investment Management Co. and Oaktree Capital Management, according to people familiar with the matter.
items.summary: Arini Capital Management, which has been suffering losses, received bids on some of its high-yield debt holdings from asset managers including PIMCO and Oaktree Capital Management.
items.title_hi: नुकसान बढ़ने के बीच अरिनी के जंक डेट पर PIMCO और Oaktree से बोलियाँ मिलीं
items.summary_hi: नुकसान झेल रही अरिनी कैपिटल मैनेजमेंट को अपने हाई-यील्ड डेट होल्डिंग्स पर PIMCO और Oaktree कैपिटल मैनेजमेंट जैसे एसेट मैनेजर्स से बोलियाँ मिली हैं।

items.title: Govt extends customs duty exemption on cotton imports till December 31
items.text: The two-month extension aims to improve cotton availability, ease input costs for textile and apparel manufacturers, and provide relief to small and medium enterprises
items.summary: The government extended the customs duty exemption on cotton imports until December 31. The two-month extension aims to improve cotton availability and reduce costs for textile manufacturers and small businesses.
items.title_hi: सरकार ने कपास आयात पर सीमा शुल्क छूट 31 दिसंबर तक बढ़ाई
items.summary_hi: सरकार ने कपास आयात पर सीमा शुल्क छूट को 31 दिसंबर तक दो महीने के लिए बढ़ा दिया है। इसका उद्देश्य कपास की उपलब्धता बढ़ाना, कपड़ा निर्माताओं की लागत कम करना और छोटे-मध्यम उद्यमों को राहत देना है।

items.title: ‘I will serve people till my last breath’: PM Modi responds to Kharge's remarks
items.text: During a gathering in Banaskantha, Gujarat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke passionately about his commitment to serving the public. He took jabs at the Opposition for supposedly finding enjoyment in moments of national distress and causing unrest. Modi assured farmers that the government is ensuring a steady supply of fertilizers at reasonable prices, even amid global price fluctuations due to conflicts in the Gulf, promising ongoing support for their welfare.
items.summary: At a gathering in Banaskantha, Gujarat, PM Modi pledged to serve people till his last breath. He criticized the Opposition for allegedly enjoying national distress and causing unrest. Modi assured farmers of steady fertilizer supply at reasonable prices despite global price fluctuations from Gulf conflicts.
items.title_hi: 'मैं आखिरी सांस तक लोगों की सेवा करूंगा': खड़गे की टिप्पणी पर पीएम मोदी का जवाब
items.summary_hi: गुजरात के बनासकांठा में एक सभा में, पीएम मोदी ने आखिरी सांस तक लोगों की सेवा करने का संकल्प लिया। उन्होंने विपक्ष पर राष्ट्रीय संकट में आनंद लेने और अशांति फैलाने का आरोप लगाया। मोदी ने किसानों को आश्वासन दिया कि खाड़ी संघर्षों के कारण वैश्विक मूल्य उतार-चढ़ाव के बावजूद उचित कीमतों पर उर्वरकों की नियमित आपूर्ति सुनिश्चित की जाएगी।

items.title: ISRO Launches Next-Gen Satellite To Strengthen Indigenous GPS System
items.text: NVS-03 is the third satellite of the second-generation NVS series, intended to augment the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC) system.
items.summary: ISRO launched the NVS-03 satellite, the third in the second-generation NVS series. It aims to strengthen the indigenous NavIC navigation system.
items.title_hi: ISRO ने अगली पीढ़ी का satellite launch किया indigenous GPS system मजबूत करने के लिए
items.summary_hi: ISRO ने NVS-03 satellite launch किया, जो दूसरी पीढ़ी की NVS series का तीसरा satellite है। इसका उद्देश्य NavIC navigation system को मजबूत करना है।

items.title: Amit Shah's 'Special' Offer To INDIA Bloc Before Gyanesh Kumar's 'Public Impeachment'
items.text: "I challenge both Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav right here and now. The BJP is fully prepared to discuss this in Parliament. We have nothing to hide. Let us convene a special session," Amit Shah said at a party event in Lucknow.
items.summary: Amit Shah challenges Rahul Gandhi and Akhilesh Yadav to a special parliament session. He says the BJP is ready to discuss and has nothing to hide.
items.title_hi: अमित शाह का INDIA गुट को ‘विशेष’ प्रस्ताव, ज्ञानेश कुमार के ‘सार्वजनिक महाभियोग’ से पहले
items.summary_hi: अमित शाह ने राहुल गांधी और अखिलेश यादव को विशेष संसद सत्र की चुनौती दी। उन्होंने कहा BJP चर्चा के लिए तैयार है और कुछ छिपा नहीं है।

items.title: FTAs to open $85 trillion market; traders need to expand footprint: Goyal
items.text: With India's trade pacts set to provide preferential access to its goods and services in countries with a combined GDP of USD 85 trillion in the coming years, the industry should look beyond the huge domestic market and step out of its comfort zone to expand globally, Union Minister Piyush Goyal said on Friday. He said that before 2014, India had implemented free trade agreements (FTAs) with countries having an aggregate GDP of USD 10 trillion. In the last four and a half years, the government has entered into nine trade pacts which covered 38 developed countries, having a GDP of USD 60 trilli
items.summary: India's trade agreements will give preferential access to markets with a combined GDP of $85 trillion. Before 2014, India had FTAs with countries worth $10 trillion GDP. In the last four and a half years, nine trade pacts covering 38 developed countries with $60 trillion GDP have been signed.
items.title_hi: एफटीए से 85 ट्रिलियन डॉलर का बाजार खुलेगा; व्यापारियों को पदचिह्न बढ़ाने की जरूरत: गोयल
items.summary_hi: भारत के व्यापार समझौते 85 ट्रिलियन डॉलर के संयुक्त जीडीपी वाले बाजारों तक तरजीही पहुंच देंगे। 2014 से पहले, भारत के पास 10 ट्रिलियन डॉलर जीडीपी वाले देशों के साथ एफटीए थे। पिछले साढ़े चार वर्षों में, 38 विकसित देशों जिनका जीडीपी 60 ट्रिलियन डॉलर है, के साथ नौ व्यापार समझौते हुए हैं।

items.title: UP CEO seeks explanation from Pilibhit poll officer over approval of erroneous forms
items.text: Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa is demanding answers regarding the validation of questionable voter registration forms. An investigation disclosed that 13,779 forms were wrongly included on the voter list, with 10,470 of these receiving improper approval. This situation has prompted scrutiny of both past and present district election officers, with clarifications anticipated from those overseeing the registration procedures.
items.summary: UP Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa seeks explanation from Pilibhit poll officer over erroneous voter forms. Investigation found 13,779 forms wrongly added to voter list, with 10,470 improperly approved. Past and present district election officers face scrutiny.
items.title_hi: यूपी सीईओ ने पीलीभीत चुनाव अधिकारी से गलत फॉर्म मंजूर करने पर स्पष्टीकरण मांगा
items.summary_hi: यूपी के मुख्य चुनाव अधिकारी नवदीप रिनवा ने पीलीभीत के चुनाव अधिकारी से गलत मतदाता फॉर्म मंजूर करने पर स्पष्टीकरण मांगा। जांच में 13,779 फॉर्म गलत तरीके से मतदाता सूची में शामिल मिले, जिनमें से 10,470 को अनुचित मंजूरी दी गई थी। पूर्व और वर्तमान जिला चुनाव अधिकारी जांच के दायरे में हैं।

items.title: Delhi Records Coldest October Day In 75 Years After Heavy Rain, Clean Air
items.text: The sudden dip in temperatures, with shallow fog during early morning and late evening hours, had residents reaching for warm clothes as the mercury remained well below normal.
items.summary: Delhi recorded its coldest October day in 75 years after heavy rain and clean air. Temperatures dropped sharply with shallow fog, making residents wear warm clothes.
items.title_hi: दिल्ली में 75 साल में सबसे ठंडा अक्टूबर दिवस भारी बारिश और साफ हवा के बाद
items.summary_hi: भारी बारिश और साफ हवा के बाद दिल्ली में 75 साल का सबसे ठंडा अक्टूबर दिन दर्ज हुआ। तापमान तेजी से गिरा और हल्का कोहरा रहा, जिससे लोगों को गर्म कपड़े पहनने पड़े।

items.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% as Google's AI search threatens traffic and user growth
items.text: Reddit shares plunged 23% after the company warned that Google's AI powered search features were hurting referral traffic and could lead to a decline in daily active users. Pinterest also fell after issuing a weaker revenue outlook, as pressure on European cross border sellers weighed on its business and growth expectations.
items.summary: Reddit shares fell sharply after the company warned that Google's AI-powered search features are hurting referral traffic and could reduce daily active users. Pinterest also dropped after giving a weaker revenue outlook.
items.title_hi: रेडिट का शेयर 30% गिरा क्योंकि गूगल के AI सर्च से ट्रैफिक और यूजर ग्रोथ को खतरा
items.summary_hi: रेडिट के शेयर तेज़ी से गिरे क्योंकि कंपनी ने चेताया कि गूगल के AI-आधारित सर्च फीचर रेफरल ट्रैफिक घटा रहे हैं और डेली एक्टिव यूजर्स कम हो सकते हैं। पिंटरेस्ट भी कमजोर रेवेन्यू आउटलुक के बाद गिरा।

items.title: Wall Street slides as AI cash burn worries spark tech selloff
items.text: USA-STOCKS/ (UPDATE 5):US STOCKS-Wall Street slides as AI cash burn worries spark tech selloff
items.summary: Wall Street slid as worries about AI cash burn sparked a tech selloff. The update indicates US stocks declined on these concerns.
items.title_hi: वॉल स्ट्रीट फिसला क्योंकि AI नकदी खर्च की चिंताओं ने टेक बिकवाली शुरू की
items.summary_hi: वॉल स्ट्रीट फिसला क्योंकि AI नकदी खर्च की चिंताओं ने टेक बिकवाली शुरू की। अपडेट के अनुसार US स्टॉक्स इन चिंताओं पर गिरे।

items.title: Delhivery Q2 Results: Revenue crosses ₹3,000 crore for first time; EBITDA nearly triples
items.summary: Delhivery's Q2 revenue crossed ₹3,000 crore for the first time. EBITDA nearly tripled.
items.title_hi: Delhivery Q2 परिणाम: राजस्व पहली बार ₹3,000 करोड़ के पार; EBITDA लगभग तीन गुना बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: Delhivery का Q2 राजस्व पहली बार ₹3,000 करोड़ के पार पहुंचा। EBITDA लगभग तीन गुना बढ़ा।

items.title: Tilaknagar Industries Q2 results: Net profit falls 57.7% to ₹22.3 crore, revenue at ₹2,438 crore
items.summary: Tilaknagar Industries reported Q2 net profit of ₹22.3 crore, down 57.7%. Revenue stood at ₹2,438 crore.
items.title_hi: तिलकनगर इंडस्ट्रीज Q2 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ 57.7% गिरकर ₹22.3 करोड़, राजस्व ₹2,438 करोड़
items.summary_hi: तिलकनगर इंडस्ट्रीज ने Q2 शुद्ध लाभ ₹22.3 करोड़ बताया, जो 57.7% कम है। राजस्व ₹2,438 करोड़ रहा।

items.title: Gail's net profit zooms two-fold to ₹4,724 crore on robust volumes
items.text: GAIL's Q2 net profit jumps 138% to ₹4,724 crore, supported by strong gas transmission and marketing volumes; board approves plans to list subsidiary GAIL Gas through an IPO
items.summary: GAIL's Q2 net profit jumped 138% to ₹4,724 crore due to strong gas transmission and marketing volumes. The board approved plans to list subsidiary GAIL Gas via IPO.
items.title_hi: GAIL का शुद्ध लाभ दोगुना होकर ₹4,724 करोड़ हुआ मजबूत वॉल्यूम के दम पर
items.summary_hi: GAIL का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 138% बढ़कर ₹4,724 करोड़ हो गया मजबूत वॉल्यूम के कारण। बोर्ड ने GAIL Gas को IPO के जरिए सूचीबद्ध करने की योजना मंजूर की।

items.title: Fiscal deficit in H1 rises to 42.1% of FY27 target on higher capex, subsidies
items.text: By September 2026, the Centre's fiscal deficit had escalated to ₹7.14 lakh crore, exceeding last year's figures. This increase is fueled by a 10.7% rise in total expenditure, largely a result of heightened capital spending and food subsidies, while petroleum subsidies sharply declined. Gross tax revenue, however, saw a modest growth of 6.1%, even with lower excise duty collections attributed to tax reforms.
items.summary: The fiscal deficit in the first half reached 42.1% of the FY27 target, amounting to ₹7.14 lakh crore by September 2026. Higher capital spending and food subsidies drove a 10.7% rise in expenditure, while gross tax revenue grew 6.1%.
items.title_hi: H1 में राजकोषीय घाटा FY27 लक्ष्य का 42.1% पहुंचा, अधिक पूंजीगत खर्च और सब्सिडी के कारण
items.summary_hi: सितंबर 2026 तक पहली छमाही में राजकोषीय घाटा FY27 लक्ष्य का 42.1% यानी ₹7.14 लाख करोड़ पहुंच गया। पूंजीगत खर्च और खाद्य सब्सिडी बढ़ने से कुल खर्च 10.7% बढ़ा, जबकि सकल कर राजस्व 6.1% बढ़ा।

items.title: BJP Leader's Singer Wife, A Kabir Bhajan Gone Viral, And The 'Jantar Mantar' That Wasn't
items.text: A video of Sivasri Skandaprasad's singing performance went viral, interpreted as a dig at protests at Delhi's Jantar Mantar. What she's singing is actually attributed to the saint-poet Kabir, and he did not really mean that particular "jantar mantar". He meant something far more profound.

items.text: Reddit shares plunged 29% after the company warned that weakening Google Search referrals could drive a low double-digit decline in daily users during Q4. Its revenue forecast missed expectations, overshadowing third-quarter results that beat estimates, with revenue up 53% year over year.
items.summary: Reddit shares fell 29% due to a weak Q4 outlook and concerns about Google search traffic. The company warned of a low double-digit decline in daily users in Q4, and its revenue forecast missed expectations, despite Q3 revenue rising 53% year over year.
items.title_hi: रेडिट शेयर्स 29% क्रैश कमजोर Q4 आउटलुक, गूगल सर्च ट्रैफिक चिंताओं के बाद; अब तक की सबसे खराब 1-दिन की गिरावट के लिए तैयार
items.summary_hi: रेडिट शेयर्स 29% गिरे कमजोर Q4 आउटलुक और गूगल सर्च ट्रैफिक की चिंताओं के कारण। कंपनी ने चेतावनी दी कि Q4 में डेली यूजर्स में लो डबल-डिजिट गिरावट आ सकती है, और इसका रेवेन्यू फोरकास्ट उम्मीदों से कम रहा, जबकि Q3 रेवेन्यू 53% साल-दर-साल बढ़ा।

items.title: RIL, JPL Q2 results 2026 impact: Reliance Industries, Jio Platforms shares in focus on Monday 2 Nov - What to expect?
items.text: Reliance Industries posted record Q2 FY27 profit of ₹29,550 crore, driven by a strong recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business. Jio Platforms reported higher revenue, profit and ARPU, with 542.4 million subscribers.
items.summary: Reliance Industries posted a record Q2 FY27 profit of ₹29,550 crore due to strong recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business. Jio Platforms reported higher revenue, profit and ARPU with 542.4 million subscribers. Shares of both companies are in focus on November 2.
items.title_hi: आरआईएल, जेपीएल Q2 परिणाम 2026 प्रभाव: रिलायंस इंडस्ट्रीज, जियो प्लेटफॉर्म्स के शेयर सोमवार 2 नवंबर को फोकस में - क्या उम्मीद करें?
items.summary_hi: रिलायंस इंडस्ट्रीज ने अपने ऑयल-टू-केमिकल्स कारोबार में मजबूत रिकवरी के कारण Q2 FY27 में रिकॉर्ड ₹29,550 करोड़ का लाभ दर्ज किया। जियो प्लेटफॉर्म्स ने 542.4 मिलियन सब्सक्राइबर्स के साथ उच्च राजस्व, लाभ और ARPU की सूचना दी। दोनों कंपनियों के शेयर 2 नवंबर को फोकस में हैं।

items.title: Extreme poverty in India falls to 2.6% from 27.1%: World Bank
items.text: As many as 496 million people moved above the lower-middle-income poverty line of $4.20 a day between 2011 and 2023, according to the World Bank’s October 2026 Poverty & Equity Brief.
items.summary: Extreme poverty in India has fallen to 2.6% from 27.1% according to the World Bank. About 496 million people moved above the $4.20 daily poverty line between 2011 and 2023.
items.title_hi: भारत में अत्यधिक गरीबी 2.6% घटी 27.1% से: विश्व बैंक
items.summary_hi: विश्व बैंक के अनुसार भारत में अत्यधिक गरीबी 27.1% से घटकर 2.6% हो गई है। 2011 और 2023 के बीच लगभग 496 मिलियन लोग 4.20 डॉलर दैनिक गरीबी रेखा से ऊपर आ गए।

items.title: RIL diversifies crude sourcing, redirects exports amid Middle East disruptions
items.text: Diversified crude supplies and a shift in export destinations helped the company navigate disruptions and capture stronger refining margins during the quarter
items.summary: RIL diversified its crude oil sources and shifted export destinations during the quarter. This helped the company manage supply disruptions and achieve stronger refining margins.
items.title_hi: RIL ने कच्चे तेल के स्रोत विविध किए, मध्य पूर्व की बाधाओं के बीच निर्यात गंतव्य बदले
items.summary_hi: तिमाही के दौरान RIL ने कच्चे तेल के स्रोत विविध किए और निर्यात गंतव्य बदले। इससे कंपनी को आपूर्ति बाधाओं से निपटने और बेहतर रिफाइनिंग मार्जिन हासिल करने में मदद मिली।

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit falls 36% as litigation costs hit earnings
items.text: Sun Pharma reported a 36% decline in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 1,989 crore due to exceptional litigation and acquisition-related costs. Revenue grew 11.8%, supported by strong domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.
items.summary: Sun Pharma Q2 net profit fell 36% to ₹1,989 crore due to litigation and acquisition costs. Revenue grew 11.8% driven by domestic and emerging market sales, while US formulations weakened.
items.title_hi: Sun Pharma Q2 लाभ 36% गिरा क्योंकि मुकदमा लागत ने कमाई प्रभावित की
items.summary_hi: Sun Pharma का Q2 शुद्ध लाभ 36% गिरकर ₹1,989 करोड़ हो गया मुकदमा लागत के कारण। राजस्व 11.8% बढ़ा घरेलू और उभरते बाजारों की बिक्री से, लेकिन US फॉर्मूलेशन कमजोर रहे।

items.title: JioStar Q2 results PAT falls 13.2% to ₹1,147 crore; revenue rises 9.8%
items.text: JioStar's Q2FY27 profit fell 13.2% to ₹1,147 crore despite higher subscription and digital advertising revenue, while JioHotstar's monthly active users grew 10% to 440 million.
items.summary: JioStar's profit after tax fell 13.2% to ₹1,147 crore in Q2, while revenue increased by 9.8%. JioHotstar's monthly active users grew 10% to 440 million.
items.title_hi: जियोस्टार Q2 परिणाम: PAT 13.2% गिरकर ₹1,147 करोड़; राजस्व 9.8% बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: जियोस्टार का टैक्स के बाद लाभ Q2 में 13.2% गिरकर ₹1,147 करोड़ रहा, जबकि राजस्व 9.8% बढ़ा। जियोहॉटस्टार के मासिक सक्रिय उपयोगकर्ता 10% बढ़कर 44 करोड़ हुए।

items.title: Syrma SGS reports best-ever quarter; Q2 revenue up 73% to Rs 1,999.5 crore
items.text: Syrma SGS Technology reported an 87.2% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue increased by 73.2%, reaching a record high of Rs 1,999.5 crore. The company’s exports grew by 91% year-on-year, showcasing strong international demand. Investments are planned in collaboration with Kaga Electronics to enhance the domestic supply ecosystem.
items.summary: Syrma SGS Technology reported an 87.2% increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026. Consolidated revenue rose 73.2% to a record Rs 1,999.5 crore. Exports grew 91% year-on-year, and the company plans investments with Kaga Electronics to strengthen the domestic supply ecosystem.
items.title_hi: Syrma SGS ने सर्वश्रेष्ठ तिमाही दर्ज की; Q2 राजस्व 73% बढ़कर 1,999.5 करोड़ रुपये हुआ
items.summary_hi: Syrma SGS Technology ने सितंबर 2026 को समाप्त तिमाही में समेकित शुद्ध लाभ में 87.2% की वृद्धि दर्ज की। समेकित राजस्व 73.2% बढ़कर रिकॉर्ड 1,999.5 करोड़ रुपये हो गया। निर्यात में 91% की वार्षिक वृद्धि हुई, और कंपनी Kaga Electronics के साथ निवेश की योजना बना रही है।
items.key_numbers: Profit up 87.2% YoY · Revenue ₹1,999.5 cr (+73.2% YoY)

items.title: ANVI signs ₹5,000-crore MoU with Goa for LPG terminal to boost India’s cooking gas security
items.text: The proposed facility will connect the US Gulf Coast with Indian markets, offering an alternative supply route amid geopolitical disruptions.
items.summary: ANVI signed a ₹5,000-crore MoU with Goa for an LPG terminal to boost India's cooking gas security. The proposed facility will connect the US Gulf Coast with Indian markets, offering an alternative supply route amid geopolitical disruptions.
items.title_hi: एएनवीआई ने गोवा के साथ ₹5,000 करोड़ का LPG टर्मिनल MoU साइन किया
items.summary_hi: एएनवीआई ने भारत की रसोई गैस सुरक्षा बढ़ाने के लिए गोवा के साथ ₹5,000 करोड़ का MoU साइन किया। प्रस्तावित सुविधा US गल्फ कोस्ट को भारतीय बाजारों से जोड़ेगी, जिससे भूराजनीतिक व्यवधानों के बीच वैकल्पिक आपूर्ति मार्ग मिलेगा।

items.title: Zee Entertainment Q2 profit drops 40% to Rs 46 crore as EBITDA margin contracts to 3.2%
items.text: Zee Entertainment Enterprises reported a 40% decline in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Operating revenue increased by 13%, largely due to growth in subscription revenue supported by the FIFA World Cup 2026. Total expenditure rose by 18% primarily driven by increased programming and promotional costs. ZEE5, the company's streaming platform, showed significant growth by doubling its revenue year-on-year.
items.summary: Zee Entertainment's consolidated net profit fell 40% to ₹46 crore in Q2, while operating revenue increased by 13%. Total expenditure rose 18%, and ZEE5's revenue doubled year-on-year.
items.title_hi: जी एंटरटेनमेंट Q2 लाभ 40% गिरकर ₹46 करोड़; EBITDA मार्जिन 3.2% सिकुड़ा
items.summary_hi: जी एंटरटेनमेंट का समेकित शुद्ध लाभ Q2 में 40% गिरकर ₹46 करोड़ रहा, जबकि परिचालन राजस्व 13% बढ़ा। कुल खर्च 18% बढ़ा, और ZEE5 का राजस्व साल-दर-साल दोगुना हुआ।

items.title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
items.text: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.
items.summary: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.
items.title_hi: लोढ़ा डेवलपर्स H1FY27 शुद्ध लाभ 63% बढ़ा, पूरे साल के गाइडेंस को पार करने की उम्मीद
items.summary_hi: लोढ़ा डेवलपर्स ने मजबूत संपत्ति बिक्री और बाजार विस्तार के कारण H1FY27 में लाभ में 63% की वृद्धि के साथ ₹2,386 करोड़ दर्ज किया। डेवलपर डेटा सेंटर पर ध्यान देकर आवर्ती आय बढ़ाते हुए वार्षिक लाभ गाइडेंस को पार करने की उम्मीद करता है।

items.title: ‘2026 resembles 1991’: Why CEA V Anantha Nageswaran wants India to rethink its growth strategy — what he said
items.text: India must rethink its growth strategy as global tensions and supply-chain shocks threaten access to critical resources, Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran warned. He urged stronger domestic capabilities, diversified imports and strategic buffers.
items.summary: CEA V Anantha Nageswaran warned that 2026 resembles 1991, urging India to rethink its growth strategy due to global tensions and supply-chain shocks. He recommended stronger domestic capabilities, diversified imports, and strategic buffers.
items.title_hi: ‘2026, 1991 जैसा है’: CEA वी अनंत नागेश्वरन भारत को विकास रणनीति पर पुनर्विचार करने को क्यों कहते हैं — उन्होंने क्या कहा
items.summary_hi: CEA वी अनंत नागेश्वरन ने चेतावनी दी कि 2026, 1991 जैसा है, और वैश्विक तनाव तथा सप्लाई-चेन झटकों के कारण भारत को अपनी विकास रणनीति पर पुनर्विचार करने का आग्रह किया। उन्होंने मजबूत घरेलू क्षमताओं, विविध आयातों और रणनीतिक बफर की सिफारिश की।

items.title: Niti Aayog's Lahiri flags growth risks in case of further monetary policy tightening
items.text: In India, it's essential for policymakers to harmonize growth output with inflation expectations. Niti Aayog’s Ashok Lahiri pointed out the importance of addressing inflation alongside job creation. He urged banks to play a pivotal role in linking enterprises with financial support and investment options. To capitalize on its natural resources, West Bengal must focus on industry attraction, while effective land acquisition and good infrastructure remain key for business development.
items.summary: Niti Aayog's Ashok Lahiri warned that further monetary policy tightening could risk growth. He emphasized balancing inflation control with job creation. He also urged banks to connect enterprises with financial support and highlighted West Bengal's need for industry attraction, land acquisition, and infrastructure.
items.title_hi: नीति आयोग के लाहिड़ी ने मौद्रिक नीति और सख्त होने पर वृद्धि जोखिम की चेतावनी दी
items.summary_hi: नीति आयोग के अशोक लाहिड़ी ने चेतावनी दी कि मौद्रिक नीति और सख्त होने से वृद्धि को जोखिम हो सकता है। उन्होंने मुद्रास्फीति नियंत्रण के साथ रोजगार सृजन को संतुलित करने पर जोर दिया। उन्होंने बैंकों से उद्यमों को वित्तीय सहायता से जोड़ने और पश्चिम बंगाल में उद्योग आकर्षण, भूमि अधिग्रहण और बुनियादी ढांचे की जरूरत बताई।

items.title: RBI deliberates economic risks at 625th Central Board meeting chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra
items.text: The Reserve Bank of India conducted its 625th Central Board meeting under Governor Sanjay Malhotra. The board reviewed economic conditions and potential risks facing India’s economy while evaluating the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation’s activities. Additionally, the board members participated in the Integrity Pledge as part of Vigilance Week 2026. Deputy Governors and other board members contributed to the discussions during the meeting.

items.title: India's services trade surplus rises to $53.39 billion in Q2
items.text: The country received $113.029 billion under this head during the three months while it paid $59.637 billion, the data showed. September saw the biggest surplus at $19.208 billion while it was $17.647 billion and $16.537 billion in July and August respectively.
items.summary: India's services trade surplus rose to $53.39 billion in Q2, with receipts of $113.029 billion and payments of $59.637 billion. September recorded the highest monthly surplus at $19.208 billion, followed by $17.647 billion in July and $16.537 billion in August.

items.title: India’s FTAs to open access to $85 trillion market; Piyush Goyal urges exporters to go global
items.text: India's trade agreements are expected to provide exporters preferential access to markets with a combined GDP of $85 trillion, covering 76% of the global economy, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said. He urged businesses to expand internationally, improve product quality and build global brands as India pursues additional trade pacts.

Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged businesses to expand internationally, improve product quality, and build global brands as India pursues more trade pacts.

items.title: CBIC holds outreach programme in Chandigarh to discuss GST 2.0 reforms with taxpayers
items.text: More than 200 taxpayers and industry representatives participated in an outreach programme with CBIC leadership. The engagement aimed to discuss implementation of reforms from the 57th GST Council meeting. Key reforms include a higher threshold for criminal prosecution and improved processes for tax refunds and registration. This initiative underscores the Finance Ministry's commitment to transparency and stakeholder engagement. The implemented reforms are set to take effect from April 1, 2027.
items.summary: CBIC held an outreach programme in Chandigarh with over 200 taxpayers and industry representatives. They discussed GST 2.0 reforms from the 57th GST Council meeting, including higher thresholds for criminal prosecution and improved refund and registration processes. The reforms will take effect from April 1, 2027.

items.title: India PE/VC investments jump 45% to $7 billion in September, highest in over two years
items.text: Private equity and venture capital investments in India saw significant growth in September 2026. The total investment reached USD 7 billion, marking a substantial increase from August. Large-value deals accounted for 76% of the total investments during the July-September quarter. Despite this growth, the number of deals declined compared to last year. Investors are expected to remain cautious amid economic challenges and inflation pressures.
items.summary: India's PE/VC investments jumped 45% to $7 billion in September, the highest in over two years. Large-value deals made up 76% of total investments in the July-September quarter, though deal count fell compared to last year. Investors remain cautious due to economic challenges and inflation.

items.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 Results: Standalone profit jumps 36% YoY to Rs 6,532 crore; NII up 9
items.text: Bank of Baroda reported a 35.8% year-on-year rise in standalone net profit to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27. items.title: India’s forex reserves fall $1.2 billion to $719.74 billion as of October 24
items.text: India’s foreign exchange reserves fell by $1.2 billion to $719.74 billion in the week ended October 24, according to the RBI. The decline followed a sharper $5 billion drop in the previous week, when reserves stood at $721.02 billion, indicating continued pressure on the country's foreign exchange kitty.
items.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by $1.2 billion to $719.74 billion in the week ended October 24 according to the RBI. This follows a sharper $5 billion drop in the previous week when reserves were at $721.02 billion.
items.title_hi: भारत का विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार $1.2 अरब गिरकर $719.74 अरब हुआ, 24 अक्टूबर तक
items.summary_hi: आरबीआई के अनुसार अक्टूबर 24 को समाप्त सप्ताह में भारत का विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार $1.2 अरब गिरकर $719.74 अरब हो गया। यह पिछले सप्ताह की $5 अरब की तेज गिरावट के बाद हुआ जब भंडार $721.02 अरब था।

items.title: ICAI to issue guidance note on new audit reporting framework for multi-state cooperative societies
items.text: ICAI is set to release a guidance note on the new audit reporting framework for multi-state cooperative societies. The cooperation ministry published the Multi-State Co-operative Societies (Auditor's Report) Order, 2026, on October 14. This initiative aims to enhance financial oversight and risk detection in the cooperative sector. Auditors will need to follow a structured approach in reporting various compliance parameters.

items.text: West Asia conflict has pushed working-capital demand at Indian banks up 15-20% as rising raw-material costs and shipping delays squeeze corporate cash flows. items.title: Aditya Birla Capital Q2 profit rises 38% to Rs 1,288-cr
items.text: Aditya Birla Capital reported an impressive 38% profit increase for the September quarter of FY27, with profit after tax soaring to Rs 1,288 crore, up from Rs 933.52 crore year-over-year. Operational revenues also climbed significantly, reaching Rs 14,003 crore. Lending assets under management witnessed a robust 32% growth to Rs 2.34 lakh crore, while shares gained 1.75% on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
items.summary: Aditya Birla Capital's Q2 profit rose 38% to Rs 1,288 crore. Operational revenue reached Rs 14,003 crore. Lending assets under management grew 32% to Rs 2.34 lakh crore.

items.title: Market wrap: Shriram Finance, Nestle India, Trent, InterGlobe top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
items.text: The Nifty 50 rose 0.51% to close at 23,053.10 on Friday, while the Sensex gained 308 points to 74,459.53. Trent and InterGlobe led the gainers, while Shriram Finance and Nestle India topped the Nifty losers. Broader markets remained weak, with midcap and smallcap indices falling up to 2%.
items.summary: Nifty 50 rose 0.51% to 23,053.10 and Sensex gained 308 points to 74,459.53 on Friday. Trent and InterGlobe were top gainers; Shriram Finance and Nestle India were top losers. Midcap and smallcap indices fell up to 2%.

items.title: PIL in Madras HC seeks probe into Cockroach Janata Party leader Saurav Das's background
items.text: A businessman has approached the Madras High Court seeking an investigation into Yogesh Sharma's background. He claims Sharma, known as Saurav Das, has Nepali roots that need to be probed. The petitioner alleges that Sharma has abused the judiciary and must therefore face consequences for his actions. Additionally, he requests the blocking of Sharma's social media accounts for derogatory statements against judges.
items.summary: A businessman filed a PIL in the Madras High Court seeking investigation into Yogesh Sharma, known as Saurav Das, leader of Cockroach Janata Party. The petitioner claims Sharma has Nepali roots and has abused the judiciary, and requests blocking his social media accounts for derogatory statements against judges.
items.title_hi: मद्रास HC में PIL: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के नेता सौरव दास की पृष्ठभूमि की जांच की मांग
items.summary_hi: एक व्यवसायी ने मद्रास हाई कोर्ट में PIL दायर कर योगेश शर्मा उर्फ सौरव दास, जो कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के नेता हैं, की जांच की मांग की। याचिकाकर्ता का दावा है कि शर्मा की नेपाली जड़ें हैं और उन्होंने न्यायपालिका का दुरुपयोग किया है। साथ ही उनके सोशल मीडिया अकाउंट ब्लॉक करने की मांग की गई है।

items.title: Centre's fiscal deficit at ₹7.15 trillion in Apr-Sep, 42.1% of FY27 target
items.text: India's fiscal deficit rose from ₹5.7 trillion in April-September FY26 to ₹7.14 trillion in the first half of FY27, while capital expenditure increased to ₹6.5 trillion, according to government data
items.summary: India's fiscal deficit reached ₹7.15 trillion in April-September, which is 42.1% of the FY27 target. The deficit rose from ₹5.7 trillion in April-September FY26 to ₹7.14 trillion in the first half of FY27. Capital expenditure increased to ₹6.5 trillion according to government data.
items.title_hi: केंद्र का राजकोषीय घाटा अप्रैल-सितंबर में ₹7.15 ट्रिलियन, FY27 लक्ष्य का 42.1%
items.summary_hi: भारत का राजकोषीय घाटा अप्रैल-सितंबर में ₹7.15 ट्रिलियन पहुंचा, जो FY27 लक्ष्य का 42.1% है। घाटा अप्रैल-सितंबर FY26 में ₹5.7 ट्रिलियन से बढ़कर FY27 की पहली छमाही में ₹7.14 ट्रिलियन हो गया। सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार पूंजीगत व्यय बढ़कर ₹6.5 ट्रिलियन हो गया।

items.text: Pending delivery orders and disrupted transactions have affected small buyers, while subdued participation in the latest sale has weakened prices
items.summary: TradeForge platform glitches have disrupted tea auctions in Kochi. Pending delivery orders and disrupted transactions have affected small buyers. Subdued participation in the latest sale has weakened prices.
items.title_hi: ट्रेडफोर्ज गड़बड़ियों ने कोच्चि चाय नीलामी को बाधित किया; खरीदारों ने टी बोर्ड हस्तक्षेप की मांग की
items.summary_hi: ट्रेडफोर्ज प्लेटफॉर्म की गड़बड़ियों ने कोच्चि में चाय नीलामी को बाधित किया है। लंबित डिलीवरी ऑर्डर और बाधित लेनदेन ने छोटे खरीदारों को प्रभावित किया है। नवीनतम बिक्री में कम भागीदारी ने कीमतों को कमजोर किया है।

items.title: Sebi issues final order against Axis Capital, imposes regulatory censure; Axis Bank shares fall over 1%
items.text: SEBI has issued a regulatory censure against Axis Capital, concluding proceedings linked to September 2024 restrictions. The regulator noted no recorded investor harm or fraudulent default, while Axis Bank expects no material business impact.
items.summary: SEBI has issued a final order imposing regulatory censure on Axis Capital, closing proceedings from September 2024 restrictions. The regulator found no investor harm or fraudulent default, and Axis Bank expects no material business impact.
items.title_hi: सेबी ने एक्सिस कैपिटल के खिलाफ अंतिम आदेश जारी किया, नियामकीय निंदा लगाई; एक्सिस बैंक के शेयर 1% से ज्यादा गिरे
items.summary_hi: सेबी ने सितंबर 2024 के प्रतिबंधों से जुड़ी कार्यवाही समाप्त करते हुए एक्सिस कैपिटल पर नियामकीय निंदा लगाई। नियामक ने किसी निवेशक को नुकसान या धोखाधड़ी नहीं पाया, और एक्सिस बैंक को कारोबार पर कोई खास असर नहीं दिखता।

items.title: Rupee rises 33 paise to close at 94.93 against US dollar
items.text: The rupee closed at 94.93 against the US dollar, marking a gain of 33 paise. Positive trends in domestic markets contributed to this improvement, despite elevated crude oil prices. Foreign Institutional Investors sold equities worth Rs 943.60 crore on a net basis. The IMF advocated for exchange rate flexibility in response to energy shocks affecting the Indian economy.
items.summary: The rupee closed at 94.93 against the US dollar, gaining 33 paise. Domestic market trends helped, despite high crude oil prices. Foreign Institutional Investors sold equities worth Rs 943.60 crore net.
items.title_hi: रुपया 33 पैसे बढ़कर 94.93 प्रति US डॉलर पर बंद हुआ
items.summary_hi: रुपया US डॉलर के मुकाबले 94.93 पर बंद हुआ, 33 पैसे की बढ़त के साथ। घरेलू मार्केट ट्रेंड ने मदद की, भले ही कच्चे तेल की कीमतें ऊंची रहीं। विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशकों ने 943.60 करोड़ रुपये के इक्विटी शुद्ध आधार पर बेचे।

items.title: India's fiscal deficit for April-September at Rs 7.14 lakh crore, widens to 42.1% of FY27 aim
items.text: India's fiscal deficit for the first half of the fiscal year through September stood at Rs 7.14 lakh crore. Total receipts during this period amounted to Rs 18.35 lakh crore, representing 50.3% of the annual estimate. The Centre has budgeted a fiscal deficit of Rs 16.96 lakh crore for the full year. Major subsidy expenditures reached approximately Rs 6.55 lakh crore, affecting overall financial performance.
items.summary: India's fiscal deficit for the first half of the fiscal year reached Rs 7.14 lakh crore, amounting to 42.1% of the full-year target. Total receipts stood at Rs 18.35 lakh crore, covering 50.3% of the annual estimate. Major subsidy expenditures were around Rs 6.55 lakh crore.
items.title_hi: अप्रैल-सितंबर के लिए भारत का राजकोषीय घाटा 7.14 लाख करोड़ रुपये, FY27 लक्ष्य का 42.1% तक बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: भारत का राजकोषीय घाटा वित्त वर्ष की पहली छमाही में 7.14 लाख करोड़ रुपये तक पहुंच गया, जो पूर्ण वर्ष के लक्ष्य का 42.1% है। कुल प्राप्तियां 18.35 लाख करोड़ रुपये रहीं, जो वार्षिक अनुमान का 50.3% है। प्रमुख सब्सिडी खर्च लगभग 6.55 लाख करोड़ रुपये रहे।

items.title: Asian Paints’ consolidated profit jumps 7.5% YoY in Q2
items.text: Asian Paints reported a 7.5% year-on-year rise in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 1,067.6 crore, while net sales grew 16.9% to Rs 9,953.9 crore. Higher raw material costs weighed on margins, prompting further staggered price hikes. The company also declared a dividend of Rs 5.75 per share.
items.summary: Asian Paints' consolidated profit rose 7.5% year-on-year to ₹1,067.6 crore in Q2, while net sales grew 16.9% to ₹9,953.9 crore. Higher raw material costs pressured margins, leading to staggered price hikes, and a dividend of ₹5.75 per share was declared.
items.title_hi: एशियन पेंट्स का समेकित लाभ Q2 में 7.5% YoY बढ़ा
items.summary_hi: एशियन पेंट्स का समेकित लाभ Q2 में सालाना आधार पर 7.5% बढ़कर ₹1,067.6 करोड़ हो गया, जबकि शुद्ध बिक्री 16.9% बढ़कर ₹9,953.9 करोड़ रही। कच्चे माल की ऊंची लागत ने मार्जिन पर दबाव डाला, जिससे चरणबद्ध मूल्य वृद्धि की गई, और ₹5.75 प्रति शेयर का लाभांश घोषित किया गया।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹1,067.6 cr (+7.5% YoY) · Revenue ₹9,953.9 cr (+16.9% YoY)

items.title: He suffering from sodium-potassium imbalance: Suvendu Adhikari attacks Abhishek Banerjee over 'threat' to police
items.text: TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee has cautioned police officers against allegedly framing party workers in fabricated cases. West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari responded by claiming Banerjee is incoherent due to a sodium-potassium imbalance. Adhikari also alleged that an aide of Banerjee has provided information against him. Banerjee demanded the arrest of members of a Durga Puja committee following a tragic stampede.
items.summary: TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee warned police against framing party workers in fabricated cases. West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari claimed Banerjee is incoherent due to a sodium-potassium imbalance. Adhikari also alleged an aide of Banerjee provided information against him, while Banerjee demanded arrests after a tragic stampede at a Durga Puja event.

items.title: Karnataka urges exporters to leverage FTAs to boost trade, target $1 trillion economy
items.text: Karnataka's industries minister MB Patil has urged manufacturers and exporters to leverage free trade agreements effectively. The state has signed trade agreements with 38 countries, which could enhance market access for various products. This initiative is part of Karnataka's goal to achieve a $1 trillion economy in the future. Increasing foreign direct investment highlights the state's economic momentum and potential growth.
items.summary: Karnataka's industries minister has urged exporters to use free trade agreements to boost trade. The state has signed agreements with 38 countries, aiming to reach a $1 trillion economy. Rising foreign direct investment signals economic growth.

items.title: RBI tightens cyber checks on lenders after spate of hacks
items.text: India's banks are facing increased scrutiny from the Reserve Bank of India regarding rising cyberattacks and AI risks. Recent incidents include data leaks and unauthorized transfers from customers' accounts at major lenders. The RBI is pushing banks to investigate vulnerabilities, particularly in their application programming interfaces. Cybersecurity agency recently offered training to officials from numerous financial institutions.
items.summary: RBI has tightened cybersecurity checks on banks following a series of hacks. Banks face increased scrutiny over cyberattacks and AI risks, with recent incidents including data leaks and unauthorized transfers. RBI is pushing banks to investigate vulnerabilities, especially in APIs.

items.title: Asian shares trade mixed as concerns about AI-related issues grow
items.text: Asians shares were trading mixed early Friday, as worries about the future of artificial intelligence grew after Alphabet's stock drop dragged on US markets. Japan's benchmark Nikkei 225 dropped 2.6 per cent to 62,960.60. The Bank of Japan is closing a two-day monetary policy board meeting, but most analysts expect no action this time around after the central bank raised its benchmark rate to 1.25 per cent last month. The US has also been pressuring Japan to raise rates because of concerns about the weakening yen. In currency trading, the U.S. dollar fell to 157.50 Japanese yen from 157.65 yen
items.summary: Asian shares traded mixed early Friday as concerns about AI grew after Alphabet's stock drop affected US markets. Japan's Nikkei 225 dropped 2.6% to 62,960.60. The Bank of Japan held a monetary policy meeting with most analysts expecting no action after last month's rate hike to 1.25%. The US dollar fell to 157.50 Japanese yen from 157.65 yen.

items.title: India-EU FTA likely to rollout in mid-2027, PM Modi to travel to Brussels for official signing in December: Top EU lawmaker
items.text: The European Parliament anticipates that the India-EU Free Trade Agreement will be signed by mid-December 2026. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to attend the signing ceremony in Brussels. The agreement seeks to deepen investments and reduce supply-chain dependencies between India and the EU. Closer collaboration on defense and cybersecurity is also a priority for both parties.

The deal aims to boost investment, cut supply-chain reliance, and increase defence and cybersecurity cooperation.

items.title: What does the law say about offences committed by underage drivers? | Explained
items.text: Section 4 of the the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 specifies that no person under the age of eighteen years shall drive a motor vehicle in any public place. However, a person can drive a motorcycle without gears and with an engine capacity not exceeding 50cc after attaining 16 years.
items.summary: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 states that no one under 18 years can drive a motor vehicle in public. An exception allows a person aged 16 or older to ride a gearless motorcycle with an engine up to 50cc.

items.title: India's services economy stays resilient as 17 sectors post growth
items.text: India's services sector recorded widespread growth in August, with 17 of the 19 tracked segments expanding and 13 registering double-digit gains, according to the trial Index of Service Production (ISP). Retail trade led the expansion with 19.9% year-on-year growth, followed by repair services and real estate at 17.6% each. Banking, insurance and IT services also reported strong growth, while CareEdge Ratings estimated overall services output rose 14%.
items.summary: India's services sector showed broad growth in August with 17 of 19 segments expanding. Retail trade grew 19.9%, while repair services and real estate each grew 17.6%. CareEdge Ratings estimates overall services output rose 14%.

items.summary_hi: अगस्त में भारत के सेवा क्षेत्र में व्यापक वृद्धि हुई, 19 में से 17 खंड बढ़े। खुदरा व्यापार 19.9% बढ़ा, मरम्मत सेवाएं और रियल एस्टेट प्रत्येक 17.6% बढ़े। CareEdge Ratings का अनुमान है कि कुल सेवा उत्पादन 14% बढ़ा।

items.summary: The Committee on Tribal Unity announced a 48-hour total shutdown in Kangpokpi district starting October 29. This follows the alleged abduction of two Kuki youths from Taphou Kuki village, with demands for their immediate and safe release.

His comments were met with condemnation from other political leaders, emphasizing the need for sensitivity.
items.summary: Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad made controversial remarks about farmer suicides in Maharashtra. He suggested boycotting funerals of farmers who die by suicide to deter others. Political leaders condemned his comments and called for sensitivity.

items.title: India remains growth engine; Super El Nino impact yet to materialise: IMF
items.text: The IMF on Thursday said the impact of weather events such as the Super El Nino was yet to materialise for India, which remains the engine of growth for the world economy. The IMF listed lower crop yields, increased food price inflation and its impact on the purchasing power of households in India due to the Super El Nino. "So these are risks that we see that India faces, but right now those risks have not materialised," IMF Communications Director Julie Kozack told a press conference here. She said the IMF will reassess India's growth projections in the January World Economic Outlook update a
items.summary: The IMF says India remains the engine of growth for the world economy. The impact of Super El Nino — such as lower crop yields and higher food inflation — has not yet materialised. The IMF will reassess India's growth projections in the January World Economic Outlook update.
items.title_hi: भारत वृद्धि का इंजन बना हुआ है; सुपर एल नीनो का प्रभाव अभी सामने नहीं आया: आईएमएफ

items.text: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal expressed confidence that India would achieve its $1 trillion exports target in 2026-27 despite global uncertainties. items.title: AI and data analytics to power next phase of government audits, says CAG
items.text: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India aims to enhance audits by adopting advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning. This integration will allow for more precise identification of risks and anomalies in public governance. Data-driven audits will improve the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the auditing process. CAG intends to create a technology-enabled, citizen-centric institution, providing timely and reliable government accounts.

items.text: Yes Bank shares fell 1.15% to ₹15.43 on October 29, their lowest since April 2023, extending October losses to 29%. The decline followed the Supreme Court’s decision to uphold the reversal of the bank’s ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off, raising concerns over capital and unpaid coupons.

items.title: MLC results are out, but how does the election work? Who votes, how are members chosen?
items.text: In the recent Legislative Council elections, the BJP secured 13 seats across multiple states including Uttar Pradesh and Bihar. The Samajwadi Party and NCP followed with five and two seats respectively, while other parties earned one seat each. MLC elections differ significantly from Assembly elections, as they are not decided by a direct vote from the general public. Members are chosen through various categories, including local authorities and graduates’ constituencies.
items.summary: In the recent Legislative Council elections, the BJP won 13 seats across several states including Uttar Pradesh and Bihar. The Samajwadi Party secured five seats and the NCP got two, while other parties won one seat each. MLC members are chosen through categories like local authorities and graduates' constituencies, not by direct public vote.

items.summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Bank has partnered to invest in One Planet Partner's first private equity fund. The partnership targets deploying over ₹3,000 crore and plans its first close by 2027.
items.title_hi: Sumitomo Mitsui Bank ने One Planet Partner के पहले P-E फंड में निवेश के लिए साझेदारी की
items.summary_hi: Sumitomo Mitsui Bank ने One Planet Partner के पहले प्राइवेट इक्विटी फंड में निवेश के लिए साझेदारी की है। साझेदारी का लक्ष्य ₹3,000 करोड़ से अधिक तैनात करना है और 2027 तक पहला क्लोज करने की योजना है।

items.title: 1 House, 2 Brothers, 3 Buried Drums: UP Cops Unearth Cash Worth Crores
items.text: During the Covid-19 pandemic in 2020, two brothers abruptly left their jobs and came back to the village. Since then, locals noticed a drastic transformation in their financial status and lifestyle.
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh police unearthed cash worth crores buried in drums at a house belonging to two brothers. The brothers had returned to their village during the 2020 Covid-19 pandemic and showed a sudden change in financial status.
items.title_hi: 1 घर, 2 भाई, 3 दबे ड्रम: यूपी पुलिस ने करोड़ों की नकदी बरामद की
items.summary_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस ने दो भाइयों के घर में ड्रमों में दबी करोड़ों की नकदी बरामद की। दोनों भाई 2020 में कोविड महामारी के दौरान गांव लौटे थे और तब से उनकी वित्तीय स्थिति में अचानक बदलाव देखा गया।

items.title: NPS charge hike deferred to Dec 1: What subscribers must know about terms
items.text: PFRDA's revised fee structure includes a Rs 200 onboarding charge and an annual fee of 0.20 per cent of assets, subject to exemptions
items.summary: PFRDA has deferred the NPS charge hike to December 1. The revised fee structure includes a Rs 200 onboarding charge and an annual fee of 0.20 per cent of assets, subject to exemptions.
items.title_hi: NPS शुल्क वृद्धि 1 दिसंबर तक टाली गई: सब्सक्राइबर्स को क्या जानना चाहिए
items.summary_hi: PFRDA ने NPS शुल्क वृद्धि को 1 दिसंबर तक टाल दिया है। संशुल्क संरचना में ₹200 का ऑनबोर्डिंग शुल्क और संपत्ति का 0.20 प्रतिशत वार्षिक शुल्क शामिल है, जिसमें छूट लागू होती है।

items.title: Related-Party Nature Of Original Transaction Does Not Invalidate Independent Personal Guarantee: NCLT...
items.summary: The NCLT ruled that the related-party nature of an original transaction does not invalidate an independent personal guarantee.
items.title_hi: मूल लेनदेन की संबंधित-पक्ष प्रकृति स्वतंत्र व्यक्तिगत गारंटी को अमान्य नहीं करती: एनसीएलटी
items.summary_hi: एनसीएलटी ने फैसला दिया कि मूल लेनदेन की संबंधित-पक्ष प्रकृति एक स्वतंत्र व्यक्तिगत गारंटी को अमान्य नहीं करती।

items.title: MSCI Rejig: LIC, Meesho likely to enter India Standard Index; OFSS, Siemens Energy may be dropped
items.text: JM Financial expects the November 2026 MSCI India Standard Index review could add LIC and Meesho and exclude Oracle Financial Services Software and Siemens Energy India. The changes may generate estimated net passive inflows of about $1.4 billion; final decisions await MSCI’s announcement.
items.summary: JM Financial expects the November 2026 MSCI India Standard Index review to add LIC and Meesho while dropping OFSS and Siemens Energy India. The changes could bring about $1.4 billion in net passive inflows, pending MSCI's final decision.
items.title_hi: MSCI रीजिग: LIC, मीशो इंडिया स्टैंडर्ड इंडेक्स में शामिल हो सकते हैं; OFSS, सिमेंस एनर्जी बाहर हो सकते हैं
items.summary_hi: JM Financial को उम्मीद है कि नवंबर 2026 के MSCI इंडिया स्टैंडर्ड इंडेक्स रिव्यू में LIC और मीशो जुड़ सकते हैं, जबकि OFSS और सिमेंस एनर्जी इंडिया निकल सकते हैं। इससे करीब $1.4 अरब के नेट पैसिव इनफ्लो का अनुमान है, अंतिम फैसला MSCI का होगा।

items.title: Symphony Q2 FY27: overseas units lift consolidated revenue 31%, new product launches imminent
items.text: The overseas subsidiary IMPCO Mexico was the standout performer, with revenue up 131 per cent
items.summary: Symphony's consolidated revenue rose 31% in Q2 FY27, driven by overseas units. The Mexico subsidiary IMPCO saw revenue jump 131%, and new product launches are coming soon.
items.title_hi: सिम्फनी Q2 FY27: विदेशी इकाइयों ने समेकित राजस्व 31% बढ़ाया, नए उत्पाद लॉन्च जल्द
items.summary_hi: सिम्फनी का समेकित राजस्व Q2 FY27 में 31% बढ़ा, जिसकी अगुवाई विदेशी इकाइयों ने की। मेक्सिको की सब्सिडियरी IMPCO का राजस्व 131% उछला, और नए उत्पाद लॉन्च होने वाले हैं।

items.title: Arkade Developers Q2 Results: Profit drops sharply as revenue falls 45%
items.text: The real estate developer reported higher collections and sequential profit growth, while pre-sales declined and its upcoming project pipeline remained substantial
items.summary: Arkade Developers' Q2 profit fell sharply as revenue dropped 45%. However, the company reported higher collections and sequential profit growth, while pre-sales declined and its project pipeline remains substantial.
items.title_hi: आर्केड डेवलपर्स Q2 नतीजे: मुनाफा तेजी से गिरा क्योंकि राजस्व 45% घटा
items.summary_hi: आर्केड डेवलपर्स का Q2 मुनाफा तेजी से गिरा क्योंकि राजस्व 45% घटा। हालांकि कंपनी ने ज्यादा कलेक्शन और क्रमिक मुनाफा वृद्धि दर्ज की, जबकि प्री-सेल्स घटीं और प्रोजेक्ट पाइपलाइन काफी बड़ी बनी हुई है।

items.title: Bengal govt now free to transfer I-PAC raid obstruction case to CBI: Mamata
items.text: Mamata Banerjee informed the Supreme Court that the new government can transfer the investigation to the CBI. The Enforcement Directorate sought an independent probe into the alleged interference in its operations. Banerjee's lawyer argued that with her departure as chief minister, there is no conflict of interest anymore. The Supreme Court reserved its verdict on whether the CBI should handle the investigation.
items.summary: Mamata Banerjee told the Supreme Court that the Bengal government can now transfer the I-PAC raid obstruction case to the CBI. The Enforcement Directorate wanted an independent probe into alleged interference. The Supreme Court has reserved its verdict on whether the CBI should handle the investigation.
items.title_hi: बंगाल सरकार अब I-PAC छापा बाधा मामले को CBI को स्थानांतरित कर सकती है: ममता
items.summary_hi: ममता बनर्जी ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट को बताया कि बंगाल सरकार अब I-PAC छापा बाधा मामले को CBI को स्थानांतरित कर सकती है। प्रवर्तन निदेशालय ने कथित हस्तक्षेप की स्वतंत्र जांच की मांग की। सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने इस पर फैसला सुरक्षित रखा है कि क्या CBI को जांच संभालनी चाहिए।

items.title: Meet Rajesh Ambati, Indian-Origin Engineer Rising To A Senior Role At Apple
items.text: Ambati joined Apple in October 2009 as a senior software engineering manager, following nearly seven years at Motorola, where he worked as an engineering manager from January 2003 to November 2009.
items.summary: Indian-origin engineer Rajesh Ambati has risen to a senior role at Apple. He joined Apple in October 2009 as a senior software engineering manager after working at Motorola for nearly seven years as an engineering manager.
items.title_hi: राजेश अंबाती से मिलें, Apple में वरिष्ठ भूमिका निभाने वाले भारतीय मूल के इंजीनियर
items.summary_hi: भारतीय मूल के इंजीनियर राजेश अंबाती Apple में वरिष्ठ भूमिका पर पहुंचे हैं। वे अक्टूबर 2009 में वरिष्ठ सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियरिंग मैनेजर के रूप में Apple में शामिल हुए, इससे पहले उन्होंने Motorola में लगभग सात साल तक इंजीनियरिंग मैनेजर के रूप में काम किया।

items.title: Congress Flips MLC Polls Script In Nagpur, Jabs PM Modi, Devendra Fadnavis Over Posts
items.text: Overall, the Maharashtra results also gave the opposition MVA reasons to cheer as the alliance romped home with three out of the five seats that went to polls in the state.
items.summary: The Congress flipped the MLC polls script in Nagpur, criticizing PM Modi and Devendra Fadnavis. The opposition MVA alliance won three out of five seats in the Maharashtra MLC polls.
items.title_hi: कांग्रेस ने नागपुर में MLC चुनावों का परिदृश्य बदला, PM मोदी और देवेंद्र फडणवीस पर निशाना साधा
items.summary_hi: कांग्रेस ने नागपुर में MLC चुनावों का परिदृश्य बदल दिया, PM मोदी और देवेंद्र फडणवीस की आलोचना की। विपक्षी MVA गठबंधन ने महाराष्ट्र MLC चुनावों में पांच में से तीन सीटें जीतीं।

items.title: Arkade Developers Q2 Results: Profit drops sharply as revenue falls 45%
items.summary: Arkade Developers reported a sharp drop in profit as revenue fell 45% in Q2.
items.title_hi: Arkade Developers Q2 परिणाम: लाभ में तेज गिरावट क्योंकि राजस्व 45% गिरा
items.summary_hi: Arkade Developers ने Q2 में लाभ में तेज गिरावट दर्ज की क्योंकि राजस्व 45% गिर गया।

items.title: UK salary and per diem: When can Indians claim tax relief in India?
items.text: Tribunal ruling in New Delhi offers relief on a Rs 16.17 lakh allowance, but employees must establish their tax residency and eligibility under the India-UK tax treaty
items.summary: A tribunal ruling in New Delhi offers tax relief on a Rs 16.17 lakh allowance for Indians working in the UK. Employees must establish their tax residency and eligibility under the India-UK tax treaty to claim this relief.
items.title_hi: UK वेतन और प्रति डिएम: भारतीय भारत में कब टैक्स राहत का दावा कर सकते हैं?
items.summary_hi: नई दिल्ली में एक ट्रिब्यूनल के फैसले ने UK में काम करने वाले भारतीयों को ₹16.17 लाख के भत्ते पर टैक्स राहत दी है। कर्मचारियों को अपनी टैक्स रेजीडेंसी और भारत-UK टैक्स संधि के तहत पात्रता साबित करनी होगी।

items.title: Equitas SFB CEO P N Vasudevan resigns over perceived conflict of interest
items.text: Vasudevan says investor concerns over his daughter's association with an NBFC have weighed on the bank's stock performance; he will continue until a successor takes charge
items.summary: Equitas Small Finance Bank CEO P N Vasudevan has resigned due to perceived conflict of interest concerns. Investor worries about his daughter's association with an NBFC have affected the bank's stock, and he will remain until a successor is appointed.
items.title_hi: इक्विटास SFB के CEO पी एन वासुदेवन ने कथित हितों के टकराव पर इस्तीफा दिया
items.summary_hi: इक्विटास स्मॉल फाइनेंस बैंक के CEO पी एन वासुदेवन ने कथित हितों के टकराव की चिंताओं के कारण इस्तीफा दे दिया है। निवेशकों की चिंता कि उनकी बेटी एक NBFC से जुड़ी हैं, ने बैंक के शेयर को प्रभावित किया है, और वह उत्तराधिकारी नियुक्त होने तक पद पर बने रहेंगे।

items.title: MTAR Tech Q2 Results: Net Profit, Revenue Jump Multifold; NCLT Clears Merger Of Three Arms
items.summary: MTAR Tech's net profit and revenue jumped multifold in Q2, and NCLT cleared the merger of three arms.
items.title_hi: एमटीएआर टेक Q2 परिणाम: शुद्ध लाभ, राजस्व कई गुना बढ़े; NCLT ने तीन शाखाओं के विलय को मंजूरी दी
items.summary_hi: एमटीएआर टेक का शुद्ध लाभ और राजस्व Q2 में कई गुना बढ़े, और NCLT ने तीन शाखाओं के विलय को मंजूरी दे दी।

items.title: Suzlon Energy Q2 Results: Revenue grows 26% as quarterly deliveries hit record high
items.summary: Suzlon Energy's revenue grew 26% in Q2 as quarterly deliveries hit a record high.

items.summary_hi: सुजलॉन एनर्जी का राजस्व Q2 में 26% बढ़ा क्योंकि तिमाही डिलीवरी रिकॉर्ड ऊंचाई पर पहुंच गई।

items.title: Suzlon Energy Q2 Results: Profit plunges 69% YoY to Rs 394 crore due to one-time deferred tax
items.text: Suzlon Energy reported a 69% year-on-year profit decline to ₹394 crore in Q2 FY27, despite 26% revenue growth to ₹4,869 crore. Record turbine deliveries, a 6,009 MW order book and a ₹2,048 crore net cash position strengthened its outlook.
items.summary: Suzlon Energy's Q2 profit fell 69% year‑on‑year to ₹394 crore because of a one‑time deferred tax charge. Revenue grew 26% to ₹4,869 crore. The company also reported record turbine deliveries, a 6,009 MW order book and a ₹2,048 crore net cash position.
items.title_hi: सुज़लॉन एनर्जी Q2 परिणाम: लाभ 69% YoY गिरकर ₹394 करोड़ हुआ क्योंकि एक बार का डिफर्ड टैक्स
items.summary_hi: सुज़लॉन एनर्जी का Q2 लाभ 69% वर्ष-दर-वर्ष गिरकर ₹394 करोड़ हो गया क्योंकि एक बार का डिफर्ड टैक्स चार्ज लगा। राजस्व 26% बढ़कर ₹4,869 करोड़ हो गया। कंपनी ने रिकॉर्ड टरबाइन डिलीवरी, 6,009 MW का ऑर्डर बुक और ₹2,048 करोड़ का नेट कैश पोजीशन भी बताया।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹394 cr (−69% YoY) · Revenue ₹4,869 cr (+26% YoY)

items.title: ESAF Small Finance Bank posts Rs 160 crore Q2 profit as asset quality improves
items.text: ESAF Small Finance Bank reported a net profit of Rs 160 crore in Q2, reversing a Rs 116 crore loss in the year-ago period. Improved margins, lower provisions and stronger asset quality supported the turnaround, while advances and deposits grew 25% and 24%, respectively.
items.summary: ESAF Small Finance Bank reported a net profit of Rs 160 crore in Q2, reversing a Rs 116 crore loss a year earlier. Improved margins, lower provisions, and stronger asset quality supported the turnaround, while advances and deposits grew 25% and 24% respectively.
items.title_hi: ईएसएएफ स्मॉल फाइनेंस बैंक ने Q2 में ₹160 करोड़ लाभ दर्ज किया क्योंकि परिसंपत्ति गुणवत्ता में सुधार हुआ
items.summary_hi: ईएसएएफ स्मॉल फाइनेंस बैंक ने Q2 में ₹160 करोड़ का शुद्ध लाभ दर्ज किया, जो एक साल पहले ₹116 करोड़ के घाटे को पलट देता है। बेहतर मार्जिन, कम प्रावधान और मजबूत परिसंपत्ति गुणवत्ता ने इस बदलाव का समर्थन किया, जबकि अग्रिम और जमा क्रमशः 25% और 24% बढ़े।
items.key_numbers: Profit ₹160 cr (vs loss ₹116 cr YoY) · Revenue not given

items.title: Laurus Labs Q2 results: Net profit jumps 126% on CDMO surge; buys Canadian firm to deepen oligonucleotide...
items.summary: Laurus Labs' net profit jumped 126% in Q2 driven by CDMO growth. The company also acquired a Canadian firm to expand its oligonucleotide business.
items.title_hi: Laurus Labs Q2 परिणाम: CDMO उछाल पर शुद्ध लाभ 126% बढ़ा; कनाडाई फर्म खरीदी oligonucleotide...
items.summary_hi: Laurus Labs का शुद्ध लाभ Q2 में CDMO वृद्धि से 126% बढ़ा। कंपनी ने oligonucleotide कारोबार बढ़ाने के लिए एक कनाडाई फर्म खरीदी।

items.title: UP MLC Polls: BJP's Candidate Selection Under Lens, Samajwadi's Western Disturbance
items.text: From Agra to Varanasi and Lucknow, the BJP's candidate choices have emerged as a possible factor behind its disappointing performance. In some constituencies
items.summary: The BJP's candidate selection for UP MLC polls is under scrutiny after disappointing performance. The issue spans constituencies from Agra to Varanasi and Lucknow. Samajwadi Party's influence in western areas is also noted.
items.title_hi: यूपी एमएलसी चुनाव: भाजपा के उम्मीदवार चयन पर सवाल, सपा का पश्चिमी प्रभाव
items.summary_hi: यूपी एमएलसी चुनाव में निराशाजनक प्रदर्शन के बाद भाजपा के उम्मीदवार चयन की जांच हो रही है। यह मुद्दा आगरा से वाराणसी और लखनऊ तक के निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों में फैला है। समाजवादी पार्टी का पश्चिमी इलाकों में प्रभाव भी नोट किया गया है।

items.title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex settles 905 pts higher, Nifty ends above 22,900; Adani Ports, Kotak Bank top gainers
items.text: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Sensex closed 905.01 pts or 1.24% higher at 74,151.04, and Nifty 50 gained 237.90 pts or 1.05% to 22,936.75 on Thursday as midcap index outperformed and ended at day’s high. Realty, FMCG and PSU Bank led the sectoral gainers. Only auto and cement dipped.
items.summary: Sensex closed 905.01 points higher at 74,151.04, up 1.24%. Nifty 50 gained 237.90 points to 22,936.75, up 1.05%. Realty, FMCG and PSU Bank sectors led gains while auto and cement declined.
items.title_hi: सेंसेक्स आज | शेयर बाजार हाइलाइट्स: सेंसेक्स 905 अंक ऊपर, निफ्टी 22,900 के ऊपर; अडानी पोर्ट्स, कोटक बैंक टॉप गेनर्स
items.summary_hi: सेंसेक्स 905.01 अंक चढ़कर 74,151.04 पर बंद हुआ। निफ्टी 50 237.90 अंक बढ़कर 22,936.75 पर पहुंचा। रियल्टी, FMCG और PSU बैंक आगे रहे, जबकि ऑटो और सीमेंट गिरे।

items.title: AI firm KYVEX founder Pearl Kapur joins BJP ahead of Punjab elections
items.text: Pearl Kapur has joined the Bharatiya Janata Party as the Punjab elections approach. He aims to integrate artificial intelligence and data analytics into the party's digital outreach strategies. This move highlights the increasing importance of digital platforms in modern political campaigns.
items.summary: AI firm KYVEX founder Pearl Kapur has joined the BJP ahead of the Punjab elections. He plans to integrate artificial intelligence and data analytics into the party's digital outreach strategies.

items.text: The Indian rupee appreciated by 3 paise to reach 95.25 against the US dollar. It started the day at 95.20 but hit an intra-day low of 95.38. The dollar index rose slightly, while Brent crude oil prices were down.

items.text: Ambuja Cements Ltd reported a 90 per cent year-on-year plunge in consolidated net profit to Rs 236 crore for the September quarter, as higher fuel and logistics costs and seasonal weakness squeezed operating margins at the Adani Group company. The year-earlier profit of Rs 2,336 crore included a Rs 1,697 crore reversal of an income-tax provision, tempering the significance of the reported decline. Revenue from operations rose 0.2 per cent to Rs 9,197 crore in the quarter ended September 30, while operating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) fell 27.9 per cent
items.summary: Ambuja Cements' Q2 net profit fell 90% year-on-year to Rs 236 crore due to higher fuel and logistics costs and seasonal weakness. Revenue rose slightly by 0.2% to Rs 9,197 crore. EBITDA fell 27.9%.

items.title: Abolish LTCG, rationalise STCG, STT rates on equities: PHDCCI to Finance Ministry
items.text: PHDCCI has recommended abolishing Long Term Capital Gains tax and modifying short-term capital gains taxes. The chamber suggests increasing the holding period for long-term investments to attract genuine investors. It emphasizes that current tax structures discourage investment due to double taxation on equities. Foreign Portfolio Investors have withdrawn significant funds from Indian equities, impacting investment levels. Government analysis of these recommendations may lead to changes in tax policy and structure.
items.summary: PHDCCI has recommended abolishing long-term capital gains tax and changing short-term capital gains and securities transaction tax rates on equities. The chamber suggests increasing the holding period for long-term investments to attract genuine investors. It says current tax structures discourage investment due to double taxation, and foreign portfolio investors have withdrawn significant funds.

items.title: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: Net profit tanks 90% YoY to Rs 114 crore on tax reversal effect; revenue rises 10%
items.text: Ambuja Cements Q2 Results: The company reported a 90% year-on-year decline in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 114 crore due to a Rs 1,697 crore income tax provision reversal in the year-ago quarter. Revenue rose 10% to Rs 6,113 crore. Shareholders also approved the proposed amalgamation of ACC and Orient Cement with Ambuja, with completion expected in FY27, subject to approvals.
items.summary: Ambuja Cements' Q2 net profit dropped 90% to Rs 114 crore due to a tax reversal effect, while revenue increased 10% to Rs 6,113 crore. Shareholders approved the amalgamation of ACC and Orient Cement with Ambuja.
