items.title: BJP chief Nitin Nabin chairs meeting of party national general secretaries

items.text: SBI Funds Management Ltd, the asset manager of SBI Mutual Fund, reported a 10 per cent year-on-year increase in quarterly average assets under management (QAAUM) to Rs 13.1 lakh crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, while operating profit for the first half of the financial year rose 11 per cent to Rs 1,797 crore. Operating revenue for the six months increased 12 per cent from a year earlier to Rs 2,336 crore, the company said in a press release. Actively managed equity assets averaged nearly Rs 9 lakh crore in the September quarter, up 9 per cent year-on-year, giving the company a 1

items.title_hi: SBI म्यूचुअल फंड का AUM 10% बढ़कर ₹13.1 लाख करोड़; H1 ऑपरेटिंग प्रॉफिट 11% बढ़ा

items.text: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) case arises from the CBI's FIR, which has alleged that Yadav entered into a criminal conspiracy with the owner of Sujata Hotels, Sarla Gupta, wife of his close associate Prem Chand Gupta, a Rashtriya Janata Dal MP in the Rajya Sabha, and IRCTC officials for "undue pecuniary advantage to himself and others" between 2004 and 2014.
items.summary: The Delhi High Court has asked the Enforcement Directorate to respond to Lalu Yadav's plea against money laundering charges in the IRCTC hotel case. The ED case stems from a CBI FIR alleging criminal conspiracy between 2004 and 2014 involving Yadav, Sujata Hotels owner Sarla Gupta, and IRCTC officials for undue pecuniary advantage.

items.text: The Centre assured the Delhi High Court that no demolition would occur at the Race Course Masjid. The court declined to allow the worshipper to offer namaz at the mosque, while addressing the case. The petitioner seeks protection for the mosque and access for worshippers amid reported restrictions. The matter will be further reviewed with a hearing scheduled for December 16.
items.summary: The Centre told the Delhi High Court it will not demolish the Race Course Masjid until the Waqf Board's representation is decided. The court refused to allow the petitioner to offer namaz at the mosque. A further hearing is set for December 16.

items.text: Absolute and IIT Kharagpur are developing an early warning system for soybean farmers to minimize crop losses. items.title: SIR a conspiracy designed by PM Modi-Amit Shah, executed by CEC, to snatch voting right: Congress
items.text: Congress has alleged that the SIR of electoral rolls is a conspiracy against Indian voters. The party claims that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah are behind this manipulation. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh criticized the process for failing to identify significant numbers of foreign nationals among voters. The Election Commission has defended its actions but faced internal objections regarding the process.
items.summary: Congress alleges the SIR of electoral rolls is a conspiracy by PM Modi and Amit Shah, executed by the CEC, to snatch voting rights. Jairam Ramesh criticised the process for failing to identify foreign nationals. The Election Commission defended its actions but faced internal objections.

items.title: US Wins Over 23 More Countries in UN Vote Against Cuba Embargo

items.title: India’s public debt ratio to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, only major emerging economy set for a decline: RBI DG
items.text: India is the only emerging market economy among nine with GDP above $1 trillion projected to reduce its public debt ratio between 2025 and 2031, with the ratio expected to fall from 84.3% of GDP in FY26 to 75.1% in FY32, RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said.
items.summary: India's public debt ratio is projected to fall to 75.1% of GDP by FY32, making it the only major emerging economy set for a decline. RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said the ratio is expected to drop from 84.3% in FY26 to 75.1% in FY32. India is the only emerging market economy among nine with GDP above $1 trillion projected to reduce its public debt ratio between 2025 and 2031.

items.summary_hi: भारत का सार्वजनिक ऋण अनुपात FY32 तक GDP का 75.1% तक गिरने का अनुमान है, जिससे यह गिरावट वाली एकमात्र प्रमुख उभरती अर्थव्यवस्था बन जाएगी। RBI डिप्टी गवर्नर पूनम गुप्ता ने कहा कि अनुपात FY26 में 84.3% से घटकर FY32 में 75.1% होने की उम्मीद है। भारत नौ उभरती बाजार अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में से एकमात्र है जिसका GDP $1 ट्रिलियन से ऊपर है और 2025-2031 के बीच सार्वजनिक ऋण अनुपात घटने का अनुमान है।

items.title: India's industrial output growth slows to 6.7% in September as manufacturing, consumer durables lose momentum
items.text: India’s industrial output growth slowed to 6.7% in September from 7.8% in August, missing market expectations of 7.3%. Manufacturing and electricity growth moderated, while mining contracted 6.2%. Industrial production grew 6.8% in April-September, up from 4.4% a year earlier.
